question: Each of seven colleagues, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, travelled to USA for sales presentation in the months of April, May, June, July, August, September and October, in the year 2019, but not necessarily in the same order. Each colleague travelled in a different month. Exactly four people travelled after D’s trip. C travelled between the trips of E and F. G travelled in the month immediately before A’s trip. Exactly two people travelled after C’s trip. E travelled in the month immediately before B, who travelled in the month of October. Who travelled in the month of July?
solution:

Step 1: E travelled in the month immediately before B, who travelled in the month of October.
